 Analytical Mechanics Associates, Inc (AMA) is seeking a part-time intern to support the Flight Dynamics Research Facility at NASA Langley Research Center. The CAD Model Design Intern will support the Entry Systems Modeling project to develop free flight and forced oscillation model design for rapid prototype fabrication. Project activities include but are not limited to, forced oscillation and free flight tests to investigate the dynamic stability of blunt entry vehicles.  Develop models in in the form of .igs or .stp, as well as the native CAD format used for the design work
 Develop CAD models for oscillation configurations that include location of mounting interface at specified reference points,

 Create CAD solid models of free flight wind tunnel models using FDM 3D printing methods or similar.

 Requirements 
 Undergraduate or Graduate student with a degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering
 Minimum of 2 years’ experience in developing CAD models or 2 semesters of relevant CAD course

DISA Technologies develops HPSA (High Pressure Slurry Attrition) mineral processing technology. Over several years of lab, pilot, and field testing we've accumulated a large body of test data, including feed characterization, particle size, chemistry, and process performance. This data is spread across many projects, sites, and file formats. Before we can use it in analytics and machine learning, it needs to be found, catalogued, and put into a consistent format.
 Together with the ML Engineer, you'll own the consolidation of our historical test data end-to-end, working from an inventory schema, format specification template, and tabular data template we provide. The goal is a governed, catalogued set of clean data files ready to load into our cloud data platform.
 What you'll do 
 Build a complete inventory of historical data sources: location, client, project, site/program, equipment unit, date range, format, and completeness — extending and correcting an existing inventory rather than starting from scratch
 Write a short format specification for the common record types you encounter, with example files for each
 Transcribe test files into a consistent tabular template and save them to a designated staging area
